name: zcode

detect.detect_notes: ZCode desktop (observed 3.11.1) ships the CLI only as a node bundle (resources/glm/zcode.cjs; `zcode doctor`: 'default artifact: node-bundle, sea: no'); it installs NO PATH-resolvable zcode binary on Windows (verified 2026-09-10: no zcode on user/machine PATH, and Node >= 20.12 cannot spawn a .cmd/.cjs shim without shell:true). known_paths covers the default system-wide (%ProgramFiles%) and per-user (%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs) install dirs; an install on a custom drive/dir still needs the machine config override. Repair paths (doctor reports both): set endpoints.overrides.zcode.bin in the machine config.json to the bundle path (a .cjs is spawned via process.execPath), or create a PATH shim that execs node with the bundle.

command.argv_notes: Evidence: the retired external-agent-suite zcode adapter:258-265 (buildInvocation) + contracts required_invocation.argv_order, archived 2026-09-12: headless print is `-p <prompt> --mode yolo --json --cwd <cwd> --disallowed-tools <space-joined denylist>`; `--resume <sessionId>` is appended when continuing. CLI 0.16.5 --help (probed 2026-09-10) confirms -p/--print, --mode build|edit|plan|yolo (default yolo for --prompt), --json, --disallowed-tools as comma-or-space list. Dead flags that must never be emitted: --max-turns, --permission-mode, --allowed-tools (the retired suite adapter's DEAD_FLAGS list, archived 2026-09-12; they parse but are inert). --cwd is omitted: the worker already spawns with cwd=request.cwd and zcode sessions are cwd-bound (cwd_arg below is informational only in v0).

env._env_notes: {native_default} = paidan never sets the variable; values pass through from the caller env if present. The auth triple (ZCODE_MODEL/ZCODE_BASE_URL/ANTHROPIC_API_KEY) is zcode's native headless credential surface (adapter buildInvocation, zcode.mjs:275-277): the CLI 0.16.5 headless path does NOT read the desktop's .zcode/v2/config.json provider registry by itself (probed 2026-09-10: without the triple, stderr 'Error: Model config is missing...', exit 1). paidan never reads or stages credentials (invariant 3/4) — the triple must come from the caller's own environment or a natively configured ~/.zcode/cli/config.json (its top-level "model" string, e.g. "builtin:bigmodel-coding-plan/GLM-5.3").

permission.presets_notes: By design: zcode permission requests have NO timeout and wait forever, so headless plan/edit (read-only/workspace-write) deadlock instead of enforcing — the eight-agent probe (2026-09-09 report §1) and the suite gateway both reject non-yolo presets before submission. yolo is the only enforceable headless preset. This is the intended endpoint shape, not a gap.

denial_evidence.via: no endpoint refusal signal observed for headless yolo in 0.16.5; parser detectRefusals is an honest no-op until a real refusal shape is observed

resume.notes: Native CLI flag `--resume <sessionId>` exists (0.16.5 --help: 'Resume a persisted session by sessionId (sess_...)'). Sessions are cwd-bound (`-c/--continue` = 'resume the latest session for the current directory'); resume a run with the same cwd as its source. sessionId is extracted from the envelope sessionId field (sess_ prefix). Suite contract additionally pins same identity/mode/tool-policy/model and prior terminal state; model/permission inheritance on resume is officially unspecified. Concurrent runs on one session handle are forbidden (per-session preempt lock, bridge issue #41). Live-verified through paidan 2026-09-10: run_20260910_07255be6 (remember codename) -> run_20260910_dba2b11b (--resume same sess_ handle, same cwd) recalled the codename exactly, state completed.

models.notes: v0: heuristic read-only scan of the desktop's native .zcode/v2/config.json provider registry (enabled providers -> provider/model aliases; connection = provider id, e.g. builtin:bigmodel-coding-plan/GLM-5.3). Selection is by ZCODE_MODEL env in the caller's environment or the CLI's own model.main; paidan has no argv model flag (0.16.5 has none for headless) and never picks across connections. bigmodel-coding-plan quota is separate from the general endpoint (2026-09-09 report §5).

parser_notes: --json emits exactly one pretty-printed JSON envelope on stdout with fields sessionId/traceId/turnId/response/usage/projection (adapter extractFacts required list, zcode.mjs:432; observed live 2026-09-10, CLI 0.16.5). usage is camelCase (inputTokens/outputTokens/cacheReadTokens) -> UsageSummary with source 'provider'. Anything else on stdout degrades the parser (terminal judgment then cannot be exit-code-based).
